title: Part time Payroll Specialist
description:
Part-Time Payroll Specialist
Location: Didsbury, South Manchester
Hours: 25-30 hours per week over 5 days
Salary: Up to £35,000 FTE, plus bonus
Working pattern: Hybrid - 3 days in office, 2 days WFH

Client Details

In this role, you'll be responsible for coordinating the full UK payroll process. You'll play a key role in ensuring payroll is accurate, compliant and delivered on time, working closely with HR, Finance and external payroll providers.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of payroll operations, maintaining strong controls and identifying opportunities to improve processes. With part-time hours and a flexible hybrid working approach, we recognise the importance of finding the right balance between work and life outside the office.

Description

The key responsibilities of a Part time Payroll Specialist will be:
- Manage the end-to-end monthly UK payroll process, including data preparation, calculations, employee payments, payslips and statutory submissions.
- Ensure all payroll activities comply with UK legislation, including PAYE, National Insurance, RTI reporting, statutory payments and workplace pension obligations.
- Oversee outsourced payroll processing across four international countries, ensuring accurate data, timely approvals, appropriate funding and compliance with local regulations.
- Complete payroll reconciliations and investigate variances, providing accurate payroll data and insights to support the Finance team.
- Partner with HR to manage employee lifecycle changes, including new starters, leavers, salary adjustments, contractual changes, absences and benefits.
- Maintain effective payroll controls and accurate records, ensuring clear audit trails, appropriate documentation and robust approval processes across UK and international payrolls.
- Coordinate payroll year-end processes, support audits and system updates, and manage relationships with external payroll providers.
- Review existing payroll processes and implement improvements to enhance accuracy, efficiency and overall service delivery.
- Act as a key point of contact for payroll queries, resolving issues promptly and providing clear, reliable support to employees and internal stakeholders.

Profile

A successful Part time Payroll Specialist will have:
- Previous experience managing or coordinating an in-house UK payroll.
- Good knowledge of UK payroll legislation, including HMRC and pension requirements.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage deadlines effectively.
- Experience working collaboratively with Finance, HR and external payroll providers.
- The ability to investigate and resolve payroll queries confidently.
- Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
- The ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

Job Offer
- Salary: Up to £35,000 FTE, pro rata + bonus
- Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home
- Pension: Salary sacrifice scheme.
- Life assurance
- Enhanced sick pay: Company sick pay scheme.
- Private medical insurance: Single cover, with option to add family.
- Annual leave: 25 days plus bank holidays.
- Extra holiday: Option to buy up to 10 additional days.
- Additional paid leave for key occasions.
- Birthday day off.
- Enhanced parental leave
- Free on-site parking

Delivering a mixture of rail, civil engineering and renewables projects, the business has built an excellent reputation for quality and sustainable growth.

Role Overview

This role leads the delivery and evidencing of the organisation's Social Value commitments, alongside business-wide wellbeing, sustainability and compliance support. It combines stakeholder engagement, internal and external communications, reporting, and office and event coordination, and works closely with senior management and the Health & Safety function.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead and coordinate the organisation's Social Value strategy, ensuring commitments are delivered and evidenced across projects and business activities.
- Manage and promote employee volunteering initiatives, including identifying opportunities, coordinating participation, and recording outcomes.
- Build and maintain relationships with community groups, charities, educational establishments, and other external stakeholders.
- Track, measure, and report on social value activities, volunteering hours, sustainability targets, and associated business benefits.
- Support internal communication campaigns to increase employee engagement in social value, wellbeing, sustainability, and compliance initiatives.
- Lead on business-wide wellbeing initiatives and support H&S with Occupational Health and EAP programmes.
- Support Health & Safety initiatives by maintaining compliance calendars, monitoring key actions, and assisting with the implementation of H&S strategies.
- Support sustainability and ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) objectives through data collection, reporting, and the promotion of best practices.
- Lead, create and schedule engaging social media content to showcase the brand, including its achievements, community engagement activities, and company initiatives.
- Maintain and update corporate document templates, ensuring compliance with branding guidelines and company standards.
- Coordinate event planning and logistics, including venue bookings, travel arrangements, accommodation reservations, and attendee management.
- Assist with the preparation of reports, presentations, and communications relating to social value, sustainability, compliance, and business performance.

Additional Support (Could Assist With)
- Maintain accurate records and databases relating to office administration, social value activities, training, and compliance requirements.
- Provide ad hoc administrative and organisational support to senior management and wider business teams as required.
- Provide comprehensive administrative support to the business, ensuring the effective day-to-day operation of the office.
- Manage office compliance processes and records, ensuring documents remain accurate, up to date, and audit-ready.

About Global:

Established in 2001, Global has become a market leader and trusted recruitment partner in its chosen sectors. Delivering a tailored recruitment service to candidates and clients alike, Global works in a diverse range of industry sectors, supplying recruitment services and staffing solutions across Construction, Logistics, Rail, Industrial, and Engineering. Recruitment business acting on behalf clients nationwide.

If you believe you have the required skills, please apply by submitting your cv.

title: Temporary Customer Service Advisor (Days & Nights)
description:
As a Temporary Customer Service Advisor, you'll be the first point of contact for customers, ensuring their queries are resolved efficiently and professionally. This role covers both day and night shifts, helping the organisation provide seamless support around the clock.

Client Details

This not-for-profit organisation is based in Stockport and works to provide vital services to the local community.

Description

As a Temporary Customer Service Advisor (Days & Nights) you will:
- Answering calls and handling call-centre type queries related to customer well-being.
- Providing compassionate and empathetic care to customers.
- Updating customer accounts within a CRM system.
- Monitor and prioritise tasks during both day and night shifts.
- Ad-hoc duties as and when required.

Please note this role is a fully office-based position.

Profile

A successful Temporary Customer Service Advisor should have:
- Previous experience in a customer service, call centre, contact centre, or customer-facing environment. However, we welcome applications from candidates with transferable skills from other industries.
- Excellent communication skills and confidence when speaking with customers over the phone.
- A positive attitude with a genuine passion for delivering outstanding customer service.
- The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- A strong work ethic, proactive approach, and willingness to learn.
- Flexibility to work a rotating shift pattern, including days, evenings, and nights.
- The ability to commit to an ongoing temporary position with the potential to become permanent.

A Full UK Driving License is essential for the role & successful DBS check.

Fully flexible is required for this as it does include different shifts on a 16 week rota which include days (06:00 - 16:00pm), (14:00pm - 22:30pm) and (22:00pm - 06:00am).

Job Offer
- Immediate start
- Weekly pay
- A chance to go perm
- Day & night shift work
- Progression & development opportunities

title: Medical Receptionist / Administrator
description: The Medical Receptionist role is a key role for patient care with a responsibility to represent the vision and ethos of the NHS and practice. The successful candidate will provide a key point of contact for patients and act as a focal point of communication between patients, GPs, other medical staff and external agencies. Excelling in customer service, you will work as part of a team of receptionists, ensuring a professional image is presented at all times - rota'd between taking phonecalls from patients, front desk duties, signposting and online triage administration Answer telephone calls and manage reception duties, prioritising patients, handling queries courteously and professionally, and ensuring appointments are triaged according to practice procedures. Use the AccuRx online triage system to support GPs with daily triage requests. Signpost patients to Primary Care Network (PCN) and external support services in accordance with practice guidelines and protocols, using resources such as OneNote. Complete administrative duties accurately and promptly, maintaining up-to-date patient records and documenting all communications and activities. Support the smooth running of the practice through prescription administration, DOCMAN management, filing letters, scanning and processing correspondence, managing tasks, and registering new patients. Respond promptly and effectively to requests from GPs and clinical staff relating to patient safety. Follow practice procedures for reporting complaints and significant events to support learning and service improvement. Open the premises when required, preparing the practice for the days clinics, and secure the building at closing by checking windows, switching off lights, activating alarms and ensuring rooms are ready for the following day. Comply with Health and Safety procedures, take responsibility for personal and others safety, and promptly address or report any hazards or concerns. Comply with rules for Data Protection and Patient Confidentiality at all times. We are looking for a friendly and caring Medical Receptionist to join our supportive team based in Reddish, Stockport. You will be a key point of contact between Clinical staff an patients, ensuring patients receive excellent care and support. Each day is different, with shifts rotated from front desk duties, supporting online triage and booking appointments, and answering phone calls. Other duties can also be learnt on the job to ensure the smooth running of the surgery. Training is a mix of online, one-to-one and group training sessions throughout the year in order to meet the requirements of the practice, NHS and CQC standards. Working hours are between 30-37.5 per week, with am/ pm shifts to cover our opening hours from 8am-6.30pm and occasional extended hours on a rota basis. Probationary period of 6 months. Full and ongoing training will be provided. Benefits include starting 22 days annual leave pro rata plus Bank holidays, NHS Pension, uniform provided on completing probation, access to staff health and wellbeing support, and regular staff training days and social events. Free parking is available on site. In order to fulfil the duties of the role, we are looking for the following Personal Qualities - Excellent customer service skills. Being able to maintain a caring, courteous and professional manner in all interactions with patients, colleagues and external agencies. The ability to work independently and resourcefully with flexibility to be able to adapt and respond in a changing environment. Good written and oral communication skills and excellent attention to detail. Ability to remain calm and understanding when dealing with difficult or vulnerable patients. Ability to understand and adhere to policies and procedures. An understanding, acceptance and adherence to the need for strict confidentiality and data protection. An understanding and sensitivity to difference cultures and people from diverse backgrounds, races and protected characteristics Ability to react professionally and quickly in any situation, seeking help or providing support to others as required. An ability to use own judgement, resourcefulness, common sense and knowledge of services available to respond to patients enquiries and requests Excellent timekeeping skills and management of own workload Personal Development Recognise own development needs and take responsibility for identifying any additional training to support your performance. Ensure all mandatory and key training is completed, and to keep abreast of changes which may impact service delivery. To partake and engage in continuous improvement initiatives within the practice, in order to keep up to date with policies and procedures. Teamwork Share best practice to ensure quality of service and maintain the standards required of the practice and NHS. Actively contribute to the work of the team by taking ownership of tasks to ensure timely completion. Be flexible with work schedules to support and preserve the provision of an excellent service to patients and GPs. To be able to work without supervision Continuous Service Improvement Be confident in challenging the status quo and make constructive suggestions to improve the quality of service. Actively engage and participate in staff meetings, training days and selected management activities. To report and review learning events in order to provide an open learning culture within the team.
